name: Property tax appeals

product.purpose: Prepare evidence packets and customer-reviewed postcard proofs from county public records and customer supplied notices and comparable sales.
product.first_county_choice: Cook County, Illinois; packet preparation only until the owner confirms the launch scope and current representation rules.
product.filing_policy: The customer reviews, signs, and submits every county filing. Glacier only prepares the packet and instructions.
product.billing: Owner confirms a flat packet fee before any checkout is enabled; no contingency billing is enabled.

schedules.purpose: Refresh the public Cook County assessor parcel roll each day and keep source alerts visible.

secrets_needed: LOB_API_KEY (optional test key only; rendering local proofs needs no key)

your_steps.title: Confirm Cook County as the first launch county
your_steps.when: Before enabling customer cases or mailing
your_steps.detail: Confirm Cook County, Illinois, as packet-only launch scope and ask counsel to confirm the current agent rules. The venture spec says Cook County needs an attorney; the Assessor's current appeal rules state that a party may file without an attorney or other agent. Resolve this difference before launch. See https://www.cookcountyassessoril.gov/official-appeal-rules-cook-county-assessor and https://www.cookcountyassessoril.gov/residential-appeals.

your_steps.title: Register before Texas property-tax consulting
your_steps.when: Before adding any Texas county or providing paid representation there
your_steps.detail: Texas consultant registration is an owner action. Review eligibility and current requirements at https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/ptc/, then review the official application at https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/ptc/forms/ptc-lic-001-property-tax-consultant-registration-application.pdf. Pre-filled note: 'Please confirm whether I am eligible for Texas Property Tax Consultant registration, which education/exam and association requirements apply, and the current fee before I add a Texas county.' Do not enable Texas cases until registration and any required association are confirmed. Glacier does not create an account, enter personal information, sign, or pay.

your_steps.title: Review the first postcard and mailing list
your_steps.when: Before the first external mailing in each county or with each new card design
your_steps.detail: Review the exact proof and recipient list, confirm a clear business sender and the mail budget, then approve an external test or production send separately. This build only renders local postcard proofs and never sends to real recipients.

launch_gates: Owner confirms the initial county selection and resolves county representation rules before launch.
Owner confirms flat packet pricing and approves each first mailing list and new postcard design.
Texas work stays disabled until the owner completes required consultant registration and confirms current requirements.
Every customer reviews, signs, and submits their own county filing; Glacier does not file appeals.
